source.prompt: Instrumental background music for a classic 1990s-style Japanese fantasy role-playing game. The writing and orchestration evoke the golden age of 16-bit console RPG soundtracks (memorable singable lead melody, clear bass line, warm chords, tasteful hall reverb), but the production is high quality, warm and full, recorded with real-sounding instruments. Completely original melody. The game's world lives in an endless night lit by lanterns, lamps and great beacon fires; the score is gentle and melancholic, with warmth and a quiet, stubborn hope. A tense story scene: suspense and urgency, someone must be saved, a clock is ticking, a clear driving beat. Build in waves so it does not feel like one repeated bar. Tempo 132 BPM, 4/4 time, key of G minor. Instrumentation: sixteenth-note string ostinato, repeating low bass, long horn notes, clear drum beat, piano pulses, timpani swells. Form: ostinato intro; section A with horn line; section B where the harmony moves to E-flat and the piano takes over; a peak with timpani; back to the ostinato. Duration: 95 seconds. Instrumental only: no vocals, no singing, no spoken words, no lyrics. Keep one steady tempo and key from start to finish, no fade-in and no fade-out, no long silences; the last bar leads naturally back into the first bar so the piece loops seamlessly as game background music.
